input_convention: VCF positions are 1-based; REF/ALT are genomic forward-strand alleles

ensembl.transcript_set: Ensembl default; all transcript consequences retained
selection_rule: retain transcripts containing VEP most_severe_consequence for the input ALT
break remaining ties by transcript ID lexicographically
ensembl.mane_comparison: Also report the MANE Select transcript of the selected gene separately, even if its consequence differs from the overall most severe consequence.

clinvar.search: All 50 rsIDs OR each GRCh38 chromosome/position; retmax=10000; verify count against returned IDs
clinvar.matching: Exact canonical SPDI (NC_000021.9 or NC_000022.11, 0-based position, genomic REF, genomic ALT) and GRCh38 chromosome/position
clinvar.classification: Germline aggregate classification, review status, last evaluated date and conditions from esummary
clinvar.unavailable_date: ClinVar placeholder 1/01/01 00:00 is shown as missing; unchanged value remains in the raw response
clinvar.no_record: No exact-allele record in this search on the analysis date; this is not a benign classification

gnomad.frequency: Alternate-allele frequency, not minor allele frequency; AF = AC/AN
gnomad.callsets: Exomes and genomes reported separately; no unvalidated pooling
gnomad.missing: null or empty cell means unavailable, never zero
gnomad.quality: Raw callset filter arrays preserved; all 100 returned callset filter arrays were empty

provenance: Each downloaded JSON has a corresponding .request.json with exact URL, request body, UTC retrieval time and response headers; exports use the cached responses.
